name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
native_kbm_note: PS5 Remastered has no keyboard/mouse gameplay support; KBM controls exist only in the 2025 PC port (Nixxes). No source lists KBM support on PS4/PS5.
notes: PC keys from magicgameworld's PC controls guide, which also lists the default gamepad layout (Xbox names converted: A=CROSS, B=CIRCLE, X=SQUARE, Y=TRIANGLE, LB=L1, RB=R1, LT=L2, RT=R2, LS/RS click=L3/R3, Select=TOUCHPAD); gamepressure confirms L1 sprint, R2 reload when not aiming and L2 aim. PS5 L1 does both sprint (hold) and dodge (tap); PC splits them into LSHIFT and LALT, both mapped to L1. MOUSE1 = fire / quick throw / use (R2); reload is R2 when not aiming on PS5, PC reload key not confirmed by the source (in Part I it is MOUSE1 or R). Y = weapon action / ammo swap while aiming (TRIANGLE). Mouse wheel switches items in the weapon wheel; mapped to D-pad left/right (lower confidence). Shoulder swap (SQUARE while aiming) and scope (CROSS while aiming) have no listed PC key. Weapon slots 1-4 and gear 5-9, slow walk (LCTRL), shake flashlight (J) and Seattle map (hold touchpad) have no single PS5 button equivalent, omitted.
